## Mission
Build the design token system for the **Vela** supplement brand prototype. Tailwind 4 CSS-first config (no `tailwind.config.js`).

## Project
- Path: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Test/Ecom Design testing/`
- Stack: Vite + React 19 + Tailwind 4 (`@tailwindcss/vite`) + shadcn/ui v4
- Existing CSS: `src/index.css` already has `@import "tailwindcss";` from riko's scaffold
- shadcn already installed primitives: button, accordion, sheet, tabs, badge, separator, dialog (in `src/components/ui/`)

## Brand bible (from decoder, locked)
**Vela** — cognitive nootropic. Tagline "Clarity. Every hour."

### Palette direction
- **Base:** warm cream (#F7F4EF range) — not pure white, never sterile
- **Primary:** deep forest / midnight sage (#1C3A2F range) — authority, not cold pharma blue
- **Accent:** amber-warm gold (#C8963E range) — "candle/vela" reference, CTAs + highlights only
- **Text:** near-black warm (#1A1A18)
- **Avoid:** electric blue, neon green, pharma teal

### Flex rule
- Spec-hero + clinical variants → dark forest base
- Lifestyle + founder-video variants → cream base
- Split-hero → middle register

So we need a palette that supports BOTH light-base and dark-base variants of the same brand. Think shadcn-style `--background` + `--foreground` swap, but with the warm-cream / forest-sage character.

## Deliverables

### 1. `src/index.css` — Tailwind 4 `@theme` block
Replace placeholder. Implement:
- Full Vela color palette as CSS custom properties (50-950 scales for `cream`, `forest`, `amber`, `ink` neutrals)
- Override shadcn defaults (`--background`, `--foreground`, `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--accent`, `--muted`, `--destructive`, `--border`, `--input`, `--ring`, `--card`, `--popover`) for BOTH light + dark modes — light = cream-base, dark = forest-base
- Typography tokens: `--font-display` (serif, premium — recommend Fraunces or Söhne Mono fallback), `--font-body` (sans, neutral — recommend Inter or system-ui), `--font-mono` (for spec tables — recommend JetBrains Mono)
- Radius scale: `--radius-sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/full` — supplements lean tighter (8px-16px sweet spot, no 32px+ blob)
- Shadow scale: `--shadow-sm/md/lg/xl` — warm shadows (slight amber tint), not pure black
- Motion tokens: `--ease-out`, `--ease-spring`, `--duration-fast/base/slow` — supplements lean restrained (200-400ms, no playful bounces)
- Spacing rhythm tokens (use Tailwind 4 default scale, only add `--space-section` and `--space-section-tight` for section-level vertical rhythm)

### 2. `src/lib/tokens.ts` — TypeScript mirror
Export the SAME tokens as TS constants for inline-style edge cases (e.g., dynamic chart colors). Pattern:
```ts
export const colors = {
  cream: { 50: 'var(--color-cream-50)', ... },
  forest: { 50: 'var(--color-forest-50)', ... },
  ...
} as const;
export type Color = keyof typeof colors;
```
No `any`. Strong typing throughout.

### 3. Font loading
Add `<link>` tags or `@import` for chosen fonts. Inter via Google Fonts, Fraunces via Google Fonts. Pin weights: Inter 400/500/600, Fraunces 400/500/600.
Use `<link>` in `index.html` with preconnect for performance.

### 4. Verify shadcn primitives still render
After token swap, `Button` / `Accordion` / `Dialog` etc. must still look correct. Test by checking shadcn variable mapping.

### 5. Variant flex tokens
Add a CSS class `.theme-forest` that swaps the base layer to forest (for spec-hero + clinical variants), inheriting all other tokens. Example:
```css
.theme-forest {
  --background: var(--color-forest-950);
  --foreground: var(--color-cream-50);
  ...
}
```
Variants 1 + 5 will wrap their root in `<div className="theme-forest">`.

## Constraints
- Tailwind 4 CSS-first — NO `tailwind.config.js`
- All tokens via CSS custom properties — no hardcoded hex in components later
- No `any` in tokens.ts
- Restrained motion (premium supplement, not gamer / energy drink)
- WCAG AA contrast on all text/background pairs (verify forest-950 + cream-50, cream-50 + ink-900, amber-500 + cream-50 for CTAs)

## Verification
- `pnpm build` succeeds
- Open dev server, check no broken styles on shadcn primitives
- Spot-check contrast ratios

## Output
Confirm files written. Report under 200 words: palette ramps chosen, fonts loaded, any contrast issues caught, and final `--accent` hex used for CTAs.

This document covers the complete token system powering Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Radix UI, and Geist design systems. 6 7 --- 8 9 ## Overview 10 11 Design tokens are named entities that store visual design attributes—colors, spacing, typography, shadows, and more—defined once and reused everywhere. They enable: 12 - Consistent, scalable design systems 13 - Rapid theme switching (light/dark mode) 14 - Accessibility compliance (WCAG AA) 15 - Maintainability across large teams 16 17 The modern approach uses CSS variables as the foundation, with Tailwind CSS providing utilities on top. 18 19 --- 20 21 ## 1. Color System 22 23 ### 1.1 Semantic Color Naming 24 25 Modern SaaS design systems organize colors by **function** rather than appearance.
